title: Footing depth and bearing
test: Pass if footings bear on undisturbed soil or engineered fill and are at least 12 in. below the undisturbed ground surface, consistent with the geotechnical report. Fail if bearing or depth conflicts with these requirements.

title: Geotechnical investigation referenced
test: Pass if the foundation design references a geotechnical investigation report. Fail if no report is referenced where foundations are designed.

title: Minimum specified concrete strength
test: Pass if the specified compressive strength of structural concrete is at least 2,500 psi. Fail if a lower strength is specified. Needs review if no strength is specified.

title: Concrete cover for concrete cast against earth
test: Pass if reinforcement in concrete cast against and permanently in contact with earth has at least 3 in. of clear cover. Fail if less cover is specified.

title: Special inspection of reinforcement placement
test: Pass if the documents require special inspection of reinforcing steel placement before concrete placement. Fail if reinforced concrete is shown with no special inspection requirement.

title: Vapor retarder under slab on grade
test: Pass if a vapor retarder is specified under the slab on grade with lapped joints (at least 6 in.). Fail if omitted where the slab is over an occupied space. Needs review if not stated.
